producer_facts.value_type: Requires type(value) is int and established bound maximum, exact name and held_full_name_usage_and_ source.
producer_facts.maximum_source: Current code checks each pinned raw rune maximum against the existing mechanics effects; no guessed resource clock/history.

producer_facts.flow: Pure visual alternative explicitly outputs resources={} and says it reads no quantities.

consumer_completeness_facts.fact: Persisted-resource consumer qualification already requires value and captured_at; validates captured_at through original localtime/strftime behavior, including old accepted bool timestamps. It does not impose an int schema on the resource value.

Fresh apply does not call this saved-resource qualification. For gold/parts_count it bypasses valid_counter_resource and uses record.get(value), conditionally indexes record[value], then stores the record with captured_at. A missing value can therefore be a fresh API completeness gap, even though normal producer does not emit it.

Summary directly indexes each resource value and captured_at and formats captured_at. Complete value presence is necessary; summary string formatting alone does not prove every non-int value numerically invalid.
Gold/parts_count are passed through as copied reusable resources without the stricter held-counter proof path.

Calculation context directly reads reusable resource values for required conditions. Existing empty_slots is derived only when capacity/value are isinstance(int); independent preview JSON remains a separate calculation input.

P2_remaining_exact_source_rows.interpretation: Current priority2 remains skill timing/precision, summon modules and environment; producer/consumer safety is a bounded continuity repair, not proof of new native mechanics or P2 completion.

Root_probe_proposals_only.scope: Actual fresh API public temporary state, not fabricated OCR
Root_probe_proposals_only.proposal: On a fresh Root-bound RunState in a public temporary folder, preserve baseline source/caller/native state/disk. Apply ordinary generated-shape gold and parts_count integer records, then a physically separate API observation carrying gold:{} (or parts_count:{}) and inspect actual apply/summary/save/restart return/errors/bytes. Do not label this malformed API fixture as a normal OCR result.

Use value0, existing ordinary positive int and parts capacity metadata, omissions/resources={} and mixed independent valid observation facts. Preserve existing time conversion and accepted opaque extras; missing read remains no resource update. No guessed OCR error or new game cap.

If testing non-int value candidates or timestamp edge cases, first establish actual old public API/UI behavior separately. Source only proves producer int/omit, not blanket retrospective rejection/normalization of every legacy value.
